articles.title: Democratic socialist set to become D.C. mayor — and face Trump's pushback
articles.description: Following Zohran Mamdani's election as New York City mayor, another democratic socialist is set to become mayor of Washington, D.C.

articles.title: HSBC rolls out its first stablecoin to over 3 million everyday app users

articles.description: The Swedish automaker cited a deteriorating environment led by "tougher" market conditions in China and the U.S., which "negatively affected free cash flow."
